title: Don't make a flat line
titleKid: Don't stand in a flat line
brief: Your centre-back plays the ball into your #6, who has dropped deep to collect it.
briefKid: Your midfielder drops back next to your defenders to get the ball.
question: Your #6 has joined the back line. Where do you go?
questionKid: Your midfielder is in line with your defenders now. Where do you go?

takeaway.standard: No more than three teammates on one line across the pitch: when your #6 drops in beside the centre-backs, push up past their front line and stay wide, so the passes to you are diagonals, not flat balls along a crowded line.
takeaway.kid: Too many teammates in one flat line? Run forward and stay wide.

misconceptions.text: You stayed level with your centre-backs and the #6, so four of you stand on one flat line and every pass between you is square and easy to cut out.
misconceptions.textKid: You are in a flat line with your teammates. Run forward and stay wide.

misconceptions.text: You stepped up, but you are still behind their winger, so they can press you and the pass to you beats nobody; get past them, high and wide.
misconceptions.textKid: Keep going! Get past their winger, high and wide.

misconceptions.text: You tucked in next to your centre-back, so one opponent can press you both and the flank is empty.
misconceptions.textKid: Too close to your defender. Stay wide and run forward.

notes: Authored answer: with the #6 dropped between the centre-backs, layer A keeps the full-back level with the back line (the build-up depth floor), so the engine's best spot (about (21, 8.5)) is still flat with the centre-backs and behind their first presser, and the start scored an A. The coach's answer is high and wide: past their winger (x 23), short of their midfield line (x 38) and off the #8s' line (x 29.7). The far full-back is keyed up the flank to x 33.5 at the freeze, never on the #8s' line, so the picture shows the right shape instead of a flat five. Difficulty 0 now that standing still scores F: the answer is a clear high-and-wide spot with a full-back's zone round it.
